summary: Suzano S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing a Material Fact notice that provides forward-looking estimates for net debt, leverage, and pulp cash production costs. It sets a net debt target of US$11.0 billion and leverage below 2.5x to be reached over fiscal years 2027-2028, along with cost estimates for 2Q26 and full-year 2026. No transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or other special situation event is announced; this is a routine update of financial guidance and a commitment to transparency. The filing includes no deal terms as no acquisition, divestiture, or capital return event occurred.
